customer_id.meaning: Primary id of the customer profile (the customer reference number).

name.meaning: Customer name of record: the person's full legal name for residential customers or the registered business name for business customers.

customer_type.meaning: Customer class of record; residential customers take residential schedules and programs, business customers take general service schedules and programs.

phone_number.meaning: Primary contact phone number on the profile.

email.meaning: Contact email address on the profile.

tax_id_last4.meaning: Last four digits of the Social Security number (residential) or Employer Identification Number (business) given when the profile was opened.

billing_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the mailing address to which bills are sent.

mailing_address.meaning: Full mailing address to which bills and notices are sent.

date_of_birth.meaning: Date of birth of a residential account holder; empty for business customers.

customer_since.meaning: Date the customer profile was opened.

income_qualified_until.meaning: Last day of the customer's current household income qualification, verified through the state energy assistance program or the company's income verification; empty when the customer has never qualified.

verification_id.meaning: Primary id of the verification record (one per customer).

customer_id.meaning: Customer whose identity was checked (foreign key -> customers).

verified.meaning: Whether identity verification passed; once true it never reverts to false.

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: Moment of the most recent verification attempt.

handoff_id.meaning: Primary id of the handoff record.

customer_id.meaning: Customer transferred to a human representative (foreign key -> customers).

reason.meaning: Reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

service_account_id.meaning: Primary id of the electric service agreement (the service account number).

customer_id.meaning: Customer billed for the agreement (foreign key -> customers).

space_heating.meaning: Primary space-heating source of the premise as recorded on the start order.

service_voltage.meaning: Voltage at which the premise takes delivery.

ev_vin.meaning: 17-character vehicle identification number of the plug-in vehicle registered for Schedule REV; empty on other schedules.

start_date.meaning: Date service began (or is scheduled to begin while pending_start).

stop_date.meaning: Date the agreement closed; empty while not closed.

rate_effective_date.meaning: Date the current rate schedule took effect on the agreement.

last_status_date.meaning: Date of the most recent lifecycle status change.

account_balance.meaning: Current amount owed: the sum of all bills and charges minus all payments and credits; negative means a credit balance.

customer_id.meaning: Customer billed for the agreement (foreign key -> customers).

due_date.meaning: Payment due date printed on the bill (bill date plus the schedule's bill_due_days).

billing_period_start.meaning: First day of the billing period.

billing_period_end.meaning: Last day of the billing period (closing meter read date).

season.meaning: Pricing season, summer when the month of billing_period_end is a summer billing month.

bill_kind.meaning: Regular monthly bill or the final bill issued at closure.

read_type.meaning: How the closing meter reading was obtained.

kwh_on_peak.meaning: kWh used in on-peak hours; all kWh on flat schedules.

kwh_off_peak.meaning: kWh used in off-peak hours; 0 on flat schedules.

kwh_super_off_peak.meaning: kWh used in super off-peak hours; 0 on schedules without that period.

kwh_total.meaning: Total kWh billed for the period.

medical_allowance_kwh.meaning: Medical baseline allowance kWh applied to raise the inclining-block threshold; 0 when none.

measured_demand_kw.meaning: Highest 15-minute demand metered in the period; 0.0 where demand is not metered.

billing_demand_kw.meaning: Demand billed after ratchet and minimum; 0.0 on schedules without a demand charge.

energy_charge_amount.meaning: Energy charges including any inclining-block adder, after any primary-voltage discount.

demand_charge_amount.meaning: Demand charge after any primary-voltage discount; 0.00 where none.

amount.meaning: Total current charges of the bill (positive; raises the account balance).
